ccpa.description: Customers CCPA status, deleted or not deleted

confirmation_token.description: also referred to as contract id

contactless.description: determines whether a contract's agreement is being signed contactlessly or not

location_sequence.description: sequence id of the contract for its location

created_at.description: time at which the contract was created

actual_dropoff_at.description: time at which the vehicle was dropped off, also indicates the contract finish time

actual_pickup_at.description: time at which the vehicle was picked up, also indicates the contract start time

days_on_loan.description: number of days the vehicle has been out on loan (diff between now and actual_pickup_at, rounded up)

vehicle_stock_number.description: the attached vehicle's stock number, nil if no vehicle attached

vehicle_license.description: the attached vehicle's license plate number, nil if no vehicle attached

vin.description: the attached vehicle's VIN, nil if no vehicle attached

repair_order.description: linked repair order number, if present

purchase_order.description: linked purchase order number, if present

booking_application.description: Client application type that created the reservation (e.g. web, iphone-appstore, scheduler).

booking_channel.description: Partner integration source for the booking (e.g. mykaarma, xtime, redcap, toyota-oneapp) or dealerware for Dealerware-native bookings.

service_advisor_name.description: first and last name of the service advisor linked to contract

customer_name.description: first and last name of the customer linked to the contract

customer_profile_complete.description: indication of whether the customer's profile is complete and eligible to start a contract

vehicle_year.description: the year the vehicle was manufactured

signed.description: indicates whether or not the contract has been signed

scheduled_pickup_at.description: the time the customer has scheduled to pick up the vehicle

scheduled_dropoff_at.description: the time the customer has scheduled to drop off the vehicle

fleet_name.description: The name of the vehicle group that is assigned to the contract
